Every report
If no bridge or node nearby answers for this long, the tag sends one report that repeaters carry further.
While the tag is guarded, every report goes over the wider mesh.
Report at once when it moves
If nothing nearby answers, it goes over the wider mesh after a few seconds instead of at its next check. Uses more airtime.
